purpose: Derived AP-MS edge lists and STRING caches for the four-map bakeoff (docs/Cartograph_multimap_bakeoff.md).
string: STRING v12.0 physical subnetwork, species 9606, fetched at required_score>=150 and filtered locally so thresholds are sweepable. Unlike evidence/string_enrichment.cached.json, which is pre-filtered at >=700 and CANNOT be re-thresholded downward.

jager2011_hiv.source: IntAct/IMEx IM-17346 via PSICQUIC, format tab27
jager2011_hiv.bait_granularity: construct: processed chains kept separate (env-38427 etc.)

haas2023_iav.bait_granularity: construct: virus strains kept separate (NS1@641501 etc.)

penn2018_mtb.bait_granularity: baits identified by the TBBAIT node attribute
penn2018_mtb.note: NOT available in IntAct: pubid:30118682 returns zero records. UniProt columns empty; NDEx carries gene symbols only.

bioplex3_293t_k200.organism_pair: human x human (293T). NOT pathogen-host: the out-of-regime test.
bioplex3_293t_k200.subsample: Full network is 118,162 edges / 8,995 baits / 10,419 preys, a ~93M-pair universe. A nested random sample of 400 baits (seed 0, bait_order.json) was drawn; this file is the K=200 prefix. Preys that are themselves sampled baits are dropped to keep the map bipartite. K=25/50/100 are nested prefixes of the same ordering, so one STRING cache serves all four.
bioplex3_293t_k200.note: STRING's API rejects >2000 identifiers (400 -> 3233 preys -> HTTP 400), which is why K caps at 200.

huri2020_k200_synthbaits.source: IntAct via PSICQUIC, pubid:32296183, paged at 8000/request (162,719 records)
huri2020_k200_synthbaits.organism_pair: human x human, yeast two-hybrid. SYMMETRIC: no real baits exist.
huri2020_k200_synthbaits.bait_granularity: SYNTHETIC BIPARTITION. HuRI is symmetric, so 300 proteins were drawn at random (seed 0) and declared baits; preys are their neighbours minus the drawn set. This file is the K=200 prefix. The split is an artefact of this analysis, NOT of the assay, and exists to test whether the prey-sharing rule is about graph topology or about real AP-MS bait/prey structure.
huri2020_k200_synthbaits.note: Parsed 49,271 unique undirected human gene pairs over 7,986 proteins against HuRI's published ~53,000 / ~8,275. interactome-atlas.org was unreachable from the build host (HTTP 000), hence the IntAct route. STRING coverage of these preys is unusually thin: mean prey STRING degree 1.073 and 1298/1895 preys have zero partners, because HuRI is enriched for previously unreported interactions. That starves the STRING-GBA baseline and inflates L3's measured advantage here.
